import { createElement } from "react"; enum Event { Add(value: int), Reset } record Model { count: int; } function Reduce(current: Model, event: Event): Model { return match event { Add(value) => current with { count: current.count + value }, Reset => current with { count: 0 } }; } export function Counter(): ReactNode { state current: Model = { count: 0 }; on Apply(event: Event) => Reduce(current, event); return {current.count}; }

flow Door { board { opens: int = 0; } event Open(); state Closed initial { on Open() -> Opened { board.opens = board.opens + 1; }; } state Opened { } } export function Main(): int { const session = Door.start(); return 0; }

flow Once(value: int) -> int { state Begin initial { finish value; } } export function Main(): int { const frame = Once.step(Once.start(42)); return match frame.outcome { Active => 0, Yielded => 0, Completed(value) => value }; }
flow Mixed() -> int { board { value: int = 0; } event Go(); state Waiting initial { on Go() -> Running; } state Running { finish 42; } }

import { createElement } from "react"; flow CounterFlow(limit: int) -> int { board { count: int = 0; } state Counting initial { if (board.count == limit) { finish board.count; } board.count = board.count + 1; yield; } } export function Counter(): ReactNode { state frame: CounterFlowFrame = CounterFlow.start(2); on Tick() => CounterFlow.step(frame); return {frame.board.count}; }

import { createElement } from "react"; flow CounterFlow(limit: int) -> int { board { count: int = 0; } state Counting initial { if (board.count == limit) { finish board.count; } board.count = board.count + 1; yield; } } function StartFrame(): CounterFlowFrame { return CounterFlow.start(2); } function StepFrame(frame: CounterFlowFrame): CounterFlowFrame { return CounterFlow.step(frame); } export function Counter(): ReactNode { state frame: CounterFlowFrame = StartFrame(); on Tick() => StepFrame(frame); return {frame.board.count}; }

import { createElement } from "react"; function Next(storage: MutableArray): int { storage[0] = storage[0] + 1; return storage[0]; } export function Counter(storage: MutableArray): ReactNode { state current: int = 0; on Increment() => Next(storage); return {current}; }
